reimbursement_terms.name: reimbursement_terms
reimbursement_terms.value:
"reimbursements"."actor_id" <> "reimbursements"."peer_id" AND "reimbursements"."amount" > 0 AND cardinality("reimbursements"."split_ids") > 0
    AND "reimbursements"."method" IN ('link','record','outside') AND num_nonnulls("reimbursements"."transaction_id","reimbursements"."transfer_id") =
    CASE WHEN "reimbursements"."reopened_at" IS NOT NULL OR "reimbursements"."method"='outside' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END

transaction_comment_content.name: transaction_comment_content
transaction_comment_content.value:
("transaction_comments"."body" IS NULL AND "transaction_comments"."transaction_id" IS NULL) OR
    ("transaction_comments"."body" IS NOT NULL AND "transaction_comments"."transaction_id" IS NOT NULL AND char_length(trim("transaction_comments"."body")) BETWEEN 1 AND 1000)
